easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if its on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if its on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
